description.text: Teaching Objective This program will enable students to be qualified senior and comprehensive engineering technicians in the areas of production technology and research, engineering construction, industrial enterprises trade, and administrative management and training and so forth. Graduates are expected to apply learned knowledge and techniques of mechanical engineering, professional software, electronic and control engineering to reality, and to be capable of working in research institutes, higher education institutions and industrial enterprises for new technology and products. Main Courses The duration of study is four years. The degree courses are: Advanced Mathematics, Elementary Chinese, Intermediate Chinese, College Physics, Theoretical Mechanics, Mechanics of Materials, Fluid Mechanics, Foundation of Materials Engineering, Engineering Drawing, Foundation of Mechanical Designing, Electrotechnics & Electronic Techniques, Computer Program Design, and Control Engineering. Graduated Requirment According to the requirements for the compulsory courses’ credits, students must obtain 140 credits in course learning, 6 credits in experimental courses and 26 credits in practice courses. Students can graduate only after having obtained 165 credits according to the requirements of the Teaching Plan, 14 credits according to the requirements of the Assistant Teaching Plan and having obtained HSK-3. Degree Awarded The qualified students will be awarded the Bachelor Degree of Engineering. Future Career Graduates can be comprehensive senior engineers to design mechatronics system, do manufacture or develop new technology in the enterprises or research institute. Graduates can go to university to make search in the major. Internship Oppotunity Metalworking, mechanical drawing, mechanical design, electrical engineering and electronics practice, computer measurement and control technology of comprehensive practice, professional practice, professional design, graduation design etc.

duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering at China University of Petroleum (Huadong) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7. Resume Written in Chinese or in English 8. Information Form For CUP Foreign Students

requirements.text: 1. High school graduates 2. With good English 3. Valid passport
